extraction.Name: William Clifford
extraction.Post Office Address: Pine Ridge, South Dakota—c/o The Holy Rosary Mission
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want this patent in fee at the time he received it, for he did not want to pay taxes, but was informed that it would be assessed for taxes, for which it would finally be sold, if he did not take it, so he accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged the place to Isaac H. Chase, of Rapid City, South Dakota, for $200.00; on April 26, 1922, he cleared up this mortgage; and that he has kept his place clear of indebtedness since
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Isaac H. Chase, of Rapid City, South Dakota, for $200.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: got behind in taxes, and, on April 26, 1921, he mortgaged the place
extraction.Occupation/Income: takes care of the plumbing, at the Holy Rosary Mission; and that this is the only source of income he has, for his land is lying idle
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; good health except for his eyes, which cost him money and hinders him in doing work on a farm, so that he has to take jobs not so good in pay; 160 acre allotment; mortgage cleared April 26, 1922; has never received any help from the County, State nor the United States Government; document number 020722
